digest_title: Defensive Security Digest: Infrastructure Flaws and AI Tool Risks
dek: Today's security updates cover critical vulnerabilities in enterprise firewalls, VPNs, AI inference, model distillation defenses, and MCP package-management tools.
overview: Defenders face multiple unpatched or newly fixed flaws in enterprise and AI infrastructure today. Priorities include verifying active protections for Check Point VPNs, managing Siemens inference exposure without a patch, and securing MCP dependency tools.

stories.headline: Siemens Drops AI Inference Fix
stories.summary: Siemens confirmed no fix is planned for CVE-2025-15467 affecting its AI Lightweight Inference Server across all versions.
stories.why_it_matters: Operators must isolate workloads or plan replacements rather than awaiting a vendor patch.

stories.headline: Cross-Platform AI Distillation Guidance
stories.summary: New US guidance calls for correlated behavioral detection across identity and infrastructure layers to mitigate AI distillation.
stories.why_it_matters: Distributed extraction requires joined detection clusters rather than static rate limits alone.

stories.headline: Check Point Fixes VPN Flaws
stories.summary: Check Point disclosed CVE-2026-85102 and CVE-2026-85103 involving certificate processing and ASN.1 decoding in VPN gateways.
stories.why_it_matters: Unauthenticated remote code execution risks require verifying active protection on every process.

stories.headline: Browser-Built Phishing Campaign Observed
stories.summary: Phishing campaigns now assemble deceptive login pages inside browser sessions using blob URLs and service workers.
stories.why_it_matters: Static URL inspection fails when initial links appear trusted before rendering malicious content.

stories.headline: PAN-OS XML Buffer Overflow Fixed
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks fixed a high-severity XML processing buffer overflow affecting management and dataplane paths.
stories.why_it_matters: Exposure depends on platform type and reachable interfaces, necessitating platform-aware verification.

stories.headline: Open WebUI Fixes Redirect Flaw
stories.summary: Open WebUI version 0.11.1 addresses CVE-2026-88001, a redirect validation weakness in retrieval paths.
stories.why_it_matters: Security policy must evaluate final destinations after HTTP redirects, not just initial URLs.

stories.headline: Arista P4Runtime Vulnerability Disclosed
stories.summary: Arista addressed CVE-2026-73453, a critical code-injection flaw in P4Runtime services requiring specific feature configurations.
stories.why_it_matters: Configuration evidence is essential since exposure depends on authentication settings and enabled states.

stories.headline: Velociraptor Patches Permission Gaps
stories.summary: Velociraptor version 0.77.2 resolves permission enforcement issues in client monitoring and notebook restore workflows.
stories.why_it_matters: Defensive tooling must preserve authorization rules across indirect scheduling and recovery paths.

stories.headline: MCP Version Tool Flaw Patched
stories.summary: Version 1.4.4 of functype-mcp-server fixes CVE-2026-59176, where version values allowed arbitrary package source installations.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent tools altering dependencies require strict source boundaries to prevent unauthorized code execution.

operating_view: Maintain rigorous inventory tracking across physical, virtual, and AI infrastructure. Verify active protection states post-update and ensure component-level validation for all deployed patches and mitigations.
watch_items: Verify that VPN and firewall updates successfully activate protections on every target process and interface.
Monitor AI retrieval and assistant workflows for unexpected redirects, external fetches, and package modifications.
Enforce strict authorization and source validation across all administrative and monitoring backup paths.
caption_intro: ShadowContext brings you concise defensive security intelligence focused on verified infrastructure facts and actionable architectural controls.
